common_name: Colossus 80 Pea (High-Yield Mechanical-Harvest Purple Hull Southern Pea)

planting.note: Direct sow seeds 1 inch deep after soil has warmed to at least 65°F and all frost danger has passed; Colossus 80 is a widely grown commercial purple hull pea selected for a concentrated, mechanically harvestable pod set.

directions: Direct sow in warm, well-drained, lean to moderately fertile soil in full sun, and harvest pods once they color up to a deep purple. Colossus 80 is a widely grown purple hull cowpea developed for commercial production, bred for a concentrated fruit set that ripens in a narrow window well suited to a single mechanical or hand harvest, along with high yield and vigorous, productive vines. Its purple-hulled pods contrast clearly against the foliage, making ripe peas easy to spot for hand-picking home gardeners as well. Like other cowpeas, its roots fix atmospheric nitrogen, improving soil fertility for whatever crop follows. Harvest continuously at the fresh shelling stage for the best flavor, or allow pods to dry fully on the vine for long-term dry storage.
sources: Mississippi State University Extension — cowpea variety notes
